# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant  <sub>[v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v4 c40 P16](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Jem is considered by his mother to be perfectly beautiful. He has dimples in his elbows.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004)_

## History

Jem is born to Anne and Gilbert Blythe. His mother shamelessly breaks her vow against using baby talk the moment he is first laid in her arms, continuing to speak to him in baby talk despite his father's protests. As an infant, he makes milestone sounds such as saying 'Wow-ga.' Captain Jim leaves instructions for Jem to inherit the curious items he collected during his life. As Jem grows, he is transitioned into 'short' dresses.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 c36 P32](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0032), [v4 c36 P34](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0034), [v4 c40 P16](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0016), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053)_
